text: To be completely honest with you guys, I'm gonna write my entire review in one continuous flow using Typeless Pro. Now, I did spend some time using Typeless itself on the free version, and let me tell you, not only does it do a fantastic job, but it's really generous with how many words you get on the free plan. It's 8,000 words per week, which is huge. That's four times the amount you get from competitors that are comparable in efficiency. Typeless is genuinely awesome. I even edit with it.
